verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's docs show it automates incident Slack channels, Jira tickets and meeting bridges, and runs Slack commands such as `/fh update` that feed back into the platform's status pages. They also describe Zoom chat insights and a meeting Scribe, plus outbound webhooks and inbound webhook event sources for custom systems. However, two-way sync is only evidenced for Slack, and Teams and GitHub are never mentioned. Missing for 10: any Microsoft Teams integration, any GitHub integration, evidence of bidirectional Jira sync, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the integrations.
